thread:
June: Quick sync - following up on rate limiter surface area. I think we need a clearer interface between tenant quotas and the global fairness pool.
Ravi: Agree. The current coupling makes emergency evictions noisy.
Lena: Proposal: split quota responsibilities: local quotas (per-frontend shard) enforce immediate hard limits; central fairness pool enforces soft weights with periodic rebalancing.
June: The tricky bit is transparent accounting for token spend when a request crosses shards for model fallback.
Ravi: Suggest we include a trace_id in admit responses so charge events can be reconciled centrally. expose charge event: {trace_id, tenant_id, tokens_charged, model_variant}.
Lena: And we should tag charges with 'charge_source' - eg: ADMISSION, FALLBACK, RETRY.
June: Ops: can we include a safety cap - a tenant-level daily hard cap that overrides all soft flows?
ops-bot: safety cap feature exists; flag: tenant_daily_hard_cap.
Ravi: Edge-case: what about long streaming sessions that accumulate tokens over hours? We need a streaming token bucket that allows a limited sustained drain but prevents instantaneous burst.
Lena: Add windowed_bucket: {burst_capacity, sustained_rate_per_minute}. Admission can issue streaming grants referencing the window id.
June: Need to ensure billing counts streaming grants correctly and invoice shows streaming vs burst tokens.
Ravi: We'll add token_type label: STREAMING | BATCH | EMBEDDING.
Lena: Telemetry: emit charge_event to metrics pipeline and also central ledger for reconciliation. Use sampling for high-cardinality tenants.
June: Implementation tasks: ledger proto changes, admission header for trace_id, runtime SDK update to report charges, console update to show streaming sessions.
Ravi: I'll own SDK / ledger changes. Lena, can you update runtime to accept streaming grants?
Lena: Yup. Also add a fallback hook: if runtime rejects a streaming grant mid-session, it should try to gracefully close with a final partial response.
June: Migration: 1) add trace_id header v1, 2) support streaming grants opt-in, 3) enable safe cap enforcement in 2-week phased rollout.
ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for us-west with flag 'stream-grants' at 15% traffic.
June: One more point: fairness recalibration should not use charge events alone; it needs to factor in latency-sensitive SLOs. Add admitted request p95 latency as an input to rebalancer.
Ravi: Agree. We'll include slo_label in charge events when present.
Lena: OK good. I'll start the runtime PR and add unit tests for windowed_bucket accounting.
June: I'll draft an RFC annex for the ledger schema. Let's capture the open questions: how to backfill existing sessions, how to surface streaming tokens in invoices.
Ravi: Note: Console wants a "streaming session explorer" for debugging. Product team will join next week.
June: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link once it's drafted.
